purpose: Recent UKRI opportunity feed items. The feed may not contain all grants or application deadlines; verify each item on its official page.

records.title: ICURe Exploit 2027 to 2029
records.summary: UK registered organisations and charities can apply for up to £7 million for a three year period (financial year 2027 to financial year 2029). This funding is provided by Innovate UK to support delivery of the Innovation to Commercialisation of University Research (ICURe) Exploit programme. Innovate UK

records.title: UKRI translation: MRC proof of concept: stage one
records.summary: This funding opportunity was previously titled ‘Developmental pathway funding scheme: stage one’. Apply for funding to develop and test novel therapeutics, medical devices, diagnostics and other interventions. You must be employed at a research organisation eligible for Medical Research Council (MRC) funding. MRC

records.title: Gambling harms research and innovation partnerships: phase two
records.summary: Apply for funding to develop Gambling Harms Research and Innovation Partnerships phase two. You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for UKRI funding. AHRC ESRC Innovate UK MRC UKRI-wide

records.title: Sector transition: UKRI policy fellowships 2027
records.summary: Apply for this sector transition fellowship to transfer knowledge and skills across academic and policy sectors and increase sector porosity. This opportunity is open to early and mid-career researchers. You must hold a doctorate or equivalent research experience. You must be based at a UKRI approved organisation. AHRC BBSRC ESRC EPSRC MRC NERC STFC UKRI-wide

records.title: Scaling interoperable V2X: bidirectional charging
records.summary: UK registered organisations can apply for a share of up to £15 million for collaborative projects. The programme aims to accelerate provision of electric vehicle flexibility for the UK electricity system by 2030 through interoperable vehicle to everything (V2X) bidirectional charging. UKRI-wide

records.title: UKRI Translation: MRC Impact Acceleration Awards
records.summary: Apply to the MRC Impact Acceleration Award to address a single, high-risk development step and generate key data to de-risk a new medicine, medical device, diagnostic or other medical product. You must be based at a research organisation eligible for MRC funding. MRC

records.title: Arctic frontier: shifts in science
records.summary: Apply for funding to support a large-scale deployment of autonomy in the high Arctic Ocean, demonstrating how integrated surface and subsurface autonomy, AI-enabled mission planning, and rapid data delivery can advance knowledge. You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for UKRI funding. UKRI-wide

records.title: ESRC postdoctoral fellowships
records.summary: Apply for a postdoctoral fellowship to develop your career by consolidating your PhD through developing publications, your networks and your research and professional skills. Fellowships must be held at a research organisation that is part of an ESRC Doctoral Training Partnership. ESRC

records.title: Open-source semiconductor security
records.summary: Apply for funding to develop new secure-by-design hardware security technologies, methods and tools, strengthening the UK’s capability to design, test and assure secure hardware, using a new open-source research platform. You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for EPSRC funding. EPSRC

records.title: DRIVE35: Scale-up Fund Drawdown 6
records.summary: UK registered organisations can apply for a share of up to £150 million to create scale up manufacturing facilities for zero emission vehicle technologies. Innovate UK

records.title: ESRC applicant-led: grow awards
records.summary: Apply for funding to make a step-change in your career. Grow awards support individual researchers at key career points to develop capabilities or pivot direction, strengthening the UK’s social science research base. You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for ESRC funding. ESRC

records.title: ESRC applicant-led: explore awards
records.summary: Apply for funding to advance knowledge through ambitious, curiosity-driven social science. Explore awards support individuals or small teams to pursue bold, novel ideas within ESRC’s remit that advance knowledge. You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for ESRC funding. ESRC

records.title: UKRI translation: MRC proof of concept: stage two
records.summary: This funding opportunity was previously titled ‘Developmental pathway funding scheme’. Apply for funding to develop and test novel therapeutics, medical devices, diagnostics and other interventions. You must be employed at a research organisation eligible for MRC funding. MRC

records.title: Wearables and observables: Understanding home learning environment
records.summary: Apply for funding to develop, test and validate innovative approaches for measuring and understanding children's home learning environments and their influence on learning, development, school readiness and educational outcomes. Open to UKRI-eligible UK research organisations. UKRI-wide ESRC NERC Innovate UK AHRC BBSRC EPSRC MRC

records.title: Arctic frontier: accelerating innovation in ocean autonomy
records.summary: Apply for funding to develop technological solutions to address the challenges of operating marine autonomous vehicles in remote and exceptionally harsh environments. You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for UKRI funding. UKRI-wide

records.title: UK-Netherlands co-innovation for quantum technology 2026
records.summary: UK registered businesses can apply for a share of up to £1.5 million for projects in quantum technology. You must collaborate with at least one Netherlands based business applying under the equivalent Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO) programme. Innovate UK

records.title: Investor Partnerships: National Materials Innovation Programme one
records.summary: UK registered micro, small or medium sized businesses can apply for grant funding alongside private investment from selected investor partners. Innovate UK

records.title: 2026 to 2027 strategic Longer and Larger (sLoLa): full stage
records.summary: Apply for funding to undertake a large team-based curiosity-driven bioscience discovery research project. You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for BBSRC funding. Full stage submissions are invitation only following assessment of an sLoLa outline application. BBSRC

records.title: Doctoral focal award: chemical threat reduction
records.summary: Apply for funding to deliver a doctoral focal award (DFA), offering high quality, cohort-based doctoral training in chemical threat reduction skills related to the defence section of the UK government’s Industrial Strategy and the protection of UK national security. EPSRC

records.title: National research and training hub: electromagnetic environment
records.summary: Apply for funding to deliver a research and training hub, offering both high quality research and cohort-based doctoral training in electromagnetic environment skills related to the defence section of the UK government’s Industrial Strategy and the protection of UK national security. EPSRC
